senses.gloss:
धूप् धूप्, i. 1, धूपाय, and i. 10, धूपय, Par.
 1. To fumigate, Suśr. 1, 16, 9.
 2. To perfume, Rām. 1, 10, 30; Śiś. 4, 52.
 3. i. 10, Par. † To speak, or to shine.
 --With the prep. अव अव, To perfume, Rām. 2, 83, 16 Gorr.
 --With उप उप, To fumigate, Rām. 5, 14, 7. []
 2. To fill with smoke, MBh. 1, 815.
 --With प्र प्र, To perfume, MBh. 12, 1389.
 --Cf. τύϕω, θύψω, τῦϕος, τυϕεδανός, etc.

धूप धूप् + अ, m.
 1. Incense, Rām. 1, 5, 15.
 2. The aromatic vapour that proceeds from the burning of incense, Vikr. d. 43.
 --Comp.

धूपक i. e.
 I. धूप + क, A substitute for धूप, as latter part of comp. adj., e. g. स-धूपक, Filled with incense, Rām. 1, 73, 20.
 II. धूप् + अक, m. A preparer of perfumes, Rām. 2, 83, 13.

धूपन धूप् + अन, n.
 1. Fumigation, Suśr. 1, 133, 12.
 2. Perfuming, MBh. 13, 4749.
 3. Perfume, incense, Man. 7, 219.
 --Comp.

धूपिक धूपिक, i. e. धूप + इक, m. = धूपक
 II. Rām. 2, 90, 14 Gorr.
धूप- + पात्र धूप- + पात्र, n. a box for keeping incense.
